in_marathi.name: Jayshankar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Victory of Shankara
in_marathi.long_meaning: Jayshankar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Jaya means victory, Shankara is the name of Lord Shiva. This name signifies the victory of Lord Shiva. It is a powerful name often used for boys in Hindu tradition.

in_bengali.name: Jayshankar
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Victory of Shankara
in_bengali.long_meaning: Jayshankar একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Jaya means victory, Shankara is the name of Lord Shiva. This name signifies the victory of Lord Shiva. It is a powerful name often used for boys in Hindu tradition.
